meta.title: Canadian Business Directories for Citation Building
meta.description: Comprehensive database of Canadian business directories used for local SEO citation building. Covers national, province-specific, and industry-specific listings.

directories.name: Yellow Pages Canada
directories.notes: Requires account creation. Phone verification via SMS. Free basic listing, paid upgrades available. Most authoritative Canadian directory.

directories.name: Canada411
directories.notes: Owned by Yellow Pages group. Basic listing submission, no description or email fields. Free.

directories.name: Google Business Profile
directories.notes: Requires Google account. Postcard verification by mail (PIN code). Most critical listing for local SEO. Can verify by phone or email in some cases.

directories.name: Bing Places for Business
directories.notes: Requires Microsoft account. No phone verification needed for basic listing. Can import from Google My Business.

directories.name: Yelp Canada
directories.notes: Requires Yelp account. Phone verification sometimes required. Strong authority. Claim existing listing if possible.

directories.name: Foursquare
directories.notes: Free listing. Can claim existing venues. No email field. Good for local SEO signals.

directories.name: BBB Canada (Better Business Bureau)
directories.notes: Requires account and BBB accreditation (paid) for full listing. Can claim free basic listing but limited. Phone verification required. High authority.

directories.name: Canada Business Directory
directories.notes: Free submission. Manual review within 48 hours. No CAPTCHA. Good for quick citations.

directories.name: Cylex Canada
directories.notes: Free listing. No account required for basic submission. Moderate authority. Also shows reviews.

directories.name: Hotfrog Canada
directories.notes: Free basic listing. Account creation required. Paid upgrades available for featured placement.

directories.name: StartLocal Canada
directories.notes: Free submission. Simple form with CAPTCHA. Good for local SEO. Canadian-run directory.

directories.name: BusinessYab Canada
directories.notes: Free listing. Quick approval. No CAPTCHA. Good supplemental directory.

directories.name: iBegin Canada
directories.notes: Free listing. No email field. US-based but has Canadian category structure.

directories.name: Superpages Canada
directories.notes: Account required. Phone verification sometimes needed. Moderate authority.

directories.name: Citysearch Canada
directories.notes: Part of IAC network. Claim existing listing. Requires account.

directories.name: Kijiji Canada
directories.notes: Classifieds site, not traditional directory. Good for local presence. Free basic ads. Owned by eBay.

directories.name: Facebook Business Page
directories.notes: Requires Facebook account. Free. Highly authoritative for local SEO. Post verification sometimes required.

directories.name: Instagram Business
directories.notes: Linked to Facebook Business. Limited structured data fields. Good for brand presence more than citations.

directories.name: LinkedIn Company Page
directories.notes: Requires LinkedIn account. Free. No email field. High authority for professional services.

directories.name: Apple Maps
directories.notes: Requires Apple ID. Phone verification via automated call. Important for iOS users. Free.

directories.name: Here Maps (now part of Nokia/Ola)
directories.notes: Less commonly used now. Verification may require postcard or phone call. Free.

directories.name: Fyple Canada
directories.notes: Free listing. Quick approval. No CAPTCHA. Simple form.

directories.name: Canpages
directories.notes: Part of Yellow Pages group. Limited fields. Account suggested but not always required.

directories.name: Brownbook
directories.notes: Free listing. Quick approval. Also functions as review platform.

directories.name: Opendi Canada
directories.notes: Free basic listing. Paid options available for visibility. Part of international Opendi network.

directories.name: YellowPage.ca (variation)
directories.notes: Distinct from YellowPages.ca. Smaller directory, easier submission.

directories.name: BizYellow Canada
directories.notes: Free submission. No account needed. Basic directory.

directories.name: TopHotSpot Canada
directories.notes: Free directory. Manual approval. May have long wait times.

directories.name: BrowseBiz Canada
directories.notes: Free submission. Simple CAPTCHA. Moderate authority.

directories.name: LocalStack Canada
directories.notes: Free listing. Fast approval. Good for local citations.

directories.name: DexKnows Canada
directories.notes: Requires account. Part of Dex Media network. Phone verification sometimes needed.

directories.name: MerchantCircle Canada
directories.notes: Requires account. Phone verification needed. Also includes review features.

directories.name: Ourbis Canada
directories.notes: Free listing. Fast approval. French-friendly interface.

directories.name: CanadaBizListings
directories.notes: Free listing. No CAPTCHA. Quick approval.

directories.name: Ontario Business Directory
directories.notes: Ontario-only directory. Free submission. Good for Ontario-focused local SEO.

directories.name: Quebec Business Directory (RepertoireEntreprisesQC)
directories.notes: French-language Quebec directory. Free submission. Target Quebec businesses.

directories.name: British Columbia Business Directory
directories.notes: BC-focused directory. Free submission. Good for Vancouver and Victoria area businesses.

directories.name: Alberta Business Listings
directories.notes: Alberta-specific directory. Free. Good for Calgary and Edmonton businesses.

directories.name: Saskatchewan Business Directory
directories.notes: Saskatchewan-only directory. Free submission. Useful for Regina and Saskatoon.

directories.name: Manitoba Business Finder
directories.notes: Manitoba-focused directory. Free. Good for Winnipeg businesses.

directories.name: Nova Scotia Business Directory
directories.notes: Nova Scotia-specific. Free. Good for Halifax area businesses.

directories.name: New Brunswick Business Listings
directories.notes: New Brunswick-focused. Free submission.

directories.name: PEI Business Directory
directories.notes: Prince Edward Island-specific. Free. Small directory.

directories.name: Newfoundland & Labrador Business Directory
directories.notes: Newfoundland & Labrador-specific. Free submission.

directories.name: Yukon Business Listings
directories.notes: Yukon-only directory. Free. Good for Whitehorse area.

directories.name: NWT Business Directory
directories.notes: Northwest Territories-specific. Free. Small directory.

directories.name: Nunavut Business Listings
directories.notes: Nunavut-specific. Free. Small directory.

directories.name: Toronto Business Directory (Toronto.com)
directories.notes: Toronto-specific. Requires account. Community-focused directory with editorial content.

directories.name: Vancouver Business Listings
directories.notes: Vancouver-specific. Free. Good for local Vancouver SEO.

directories.name: Montreal Business Directory
directories.notes: Montreal-focused directory. Free. Bilingual (French/English) interface.

directories.name: Calgary Business Directory
directories.notes: Calgary-specific. Free submission.

directories.name: Edmonton Business Listings
directories.notes: Edmonton-specific. Free submission.

directories.name: Winnipeg Business Directory
directories.notes: Winnipeg-specific. Free submission.

directories.name: Ottawa Business Listings
directories.notes: Ottawa-specific. Free submission.

directories.name: Canadian Healthcare Directory
directories.notes: Healthcare-specific directory. Requires professional credentials or license verification for some categories.

directories.name: Canadian Restaurant Directory
directories.notes: Restaurant and food service focused. Free listing.

directories.name: Canadian Legal Directory (Lawyers)
directories.notes: Legal profession directory. May require law society number for verification.

directories.name: Canadian Dental Directory
directories.notes: Dental practices only. May require professional license verification.

directories.name: Canadian Construction Directory
directories.notes: Construction and trades directory. Free listing. Good for contractors.

directories.name: Canadian Real Estate Directory
directories.notes: Real estate agents and agencies. May require real estate board license number.

directories.name: Canadian Automotive Directory
directories.notes: Auto dealers, repair shops, and parts suppliers. Free listing.

directories.name: Canadian Beauty & Wellness Directory
directories.notes: Spas, salons, and wellness professionals. Free listing.

directories.name: Canadian IT & Tech Directory
directories.notes: Technology and IT services companies. Free listing.

directories.name: Canadian Hospitality & Hotel Directory
directories.notes: Hotels, motels, B&Bs, and inns. May require tourism license or registration.

directories.name: Canadian Home Services Directory
directories.notes: Home improvement, cleaning, landscaping, and trades. Free listing.

directories.name: Canadian Education Directory
directories.notes: Schools, colleges, tutors, and educational services. May require accreditation verification.

directories.name: Canadian Pet Services Directory
directories.notes: Pet groomers, vets, boarding, and trainers. Free listing.

directories.name: Canadian Financial Services Directory
directories.notes: Financial advisors, accountants, and insurance brokers. May require professional license numbers (e.g., MFDA, IIROC).

directories.name: Annuaire Quebec Entreprises
directories.notes: French-language Quebec directory. Free. Good for Quebec-based local SEO.

directories.name: Backlinks Canada
directories.notes: Canadian link building directory. Free submission. No CAPTCHA.
